headline: Sarveshwar Foods submits scrutinizer's report and voting results for its AGM
hook: AGM voting results now on record
summary: Sarveshwar Foods Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results of its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026, to the stock exchanges. This is a routine regulatory compliance filing detailing the outcome of shareholder resolutions. The filing affects holders of Sarveshwar Foods shares by formalizing the AGM proceedings. Retail investors should note this is standard corporate procedure with no direct impact on financial performance.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance update with no immediate financial impact for shareholders.
